title: Replace request's "window" with "traversable for user prompts"
body: After much discussion in #1820 and #1821, this seems to be more correct. User prompts are not tied to specific `Window`s, and certainly not to the client's `Window`. They are tied to a traversable navigable, i.e. "browser tab", and that browser tab should ideally be blanked out and updated to reflect that it's the destination that's causing the prompt, not the request client. Closes #1820. Closes #1821.
